## Design

### 2026-10-06 — I set up the project for OutBound and started making the schematic design in KiCad 10. Beacause Waveshare doesn't have a  KiCad symbol file for the ESP32-S3-A7670E-4G board on their wiki, I built a cu

**2h**

I set up the project for OutBound and started making the schematic design in KiCad 10. Beacause Waveshare doesn't have a  KiCad symbol file for the ESP32-S3-A7670E-4G board on their wiki, I built a custom 20-pin symbol from scratch inside the KiCad Symbol Editor.

What I Accomplished:
1.Custom Board Symbol:Designed and saved the `ESP32-S3-A7670E-4G` symbol with proper electrical pin types (3.3V,GND, 5V, display SPI, LED matrix output, encoder inputs, and button inputs).
2.Schematic Layout: Placed the board (U1), two rotary encoders (SW1  for the front turntable, SW2  for side volume), and two 12mm tactile push buttons (SW3 and SW4) onto the canvas.
3.KiCad Workflow:Learned how KiCad pin connection points, wire stubs, and Net Label routing work to keep complex schematics clean.

Next stuff left to do:
Attach Net Labels to all peripheral lines, add power/ground symbols, and assign physical footprints  before moving to PCB layout.
